name: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::?*/* (single-char wildcard bucket head, all objects, all buckets) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn regression (iter2): AWS IAM honors '?' (exactly-one-character) as a Resource-ARN wildcard alongside '*'. A leading '?*' on the S3 bucket-name head matches every bucket of length>=1 - i.e. EVERY bucket - identical account-wide reach to arn:aws:s3:::*/*. isBroadArnResource() previously tested only a leading literal '*' (startsWith('*')), so this '?'-spelled bulk read returned findings=[] status complete exit 0 CLEAN - the SAME DATA-EXFIL fail-open (T8) as the '*' form, just spelled with '?'. DATA-EXFIL must fire at high and the CLI must exit non-zero. GetObject is a read verb, so WILDCARD-RESOURCE must NOT fire.
